description: REQUIRES API KEY (sessions:write scope). Starts a remote session on a CONFIRMED or IN_PROGRESS Robotics & AI booking (SSH / Jupyter / VNC / API access) that the authenticated user rents. Sessions open 15 minutes before the booking's start time. Returns the session access token — shown ONCE, store it securely — plus the connection URL and allocated specs. Calling it again for the same booking while its session is live returns that session instead of starting a second one; for SSH and API access that issues a new token and the previous one stops working. Starting a new session also needs the rental agreement signed by both renter and owner; the error says who has not signed (they sign on the booking page on the web). For METERED bookings the per-minute clock runs while the session is active; call rigshare_end_session (or end the booking) to settle for exact usage. Equipment that requires MFA cannot be started via API key — the renter must use the web app.

booking_id.description: The booking to start a session on.
